summary: Completeness critique of the Phase-0 audit deliverables (wf/final/*.md, wf/design/phase0.md, wf/design/owner-decisions.md) against the owner's 10-section final response and Tasks 1–7. 54 checklist items were checked: 43 COVERED, 7 COVERED with a stated gap, 3 PARTIAL and 1 MISSING. The MISSING item is the READY / PARTIAL / NO-GO verdict; a draft is supplied (PARTIAL: GO once the start gates are answered). The 3 PARTIAL items are R1 (consolidated handoff verdict; draft supplied), T1.d (repository package/test/infrastructure inventory; draft supplied) and T5.a (Flow 1–6 ↔ A–F mapping; mapping supplied, incl. the Flow-5 step-count difference). The 7 COVERED-with-gap items are R2 (inventory), R6 (flow numbering), R9 and T7.h (phase0 ↔ owner-decisions inconsistency), R11 (no-files-changed wording), T1.e (OPEN_DECISIONS A-07/A-08/A-14 annotations) and T6.g (Chromium-only tests vs the declared browser policy). The phase0 ↔ owner-decisions gaps are the main problem: the two files give different Phase-0 gate sets (A1/A3 are not gates in phase0; install approval is absent from owner-decisions) and a contradictory Phase-0 scope (XS-01 pulled forward vs 'B8-06 governs'; TE-5 and AD-39 placed in different phases). In addition, a Phase-0 screen (XS-07) depends on UNRESOLVED items that phase0 defers to Phase 6. 16 corrections: 1 critical, 5 major, 10 minor. Read-only spot checks re-ran handoff integrity (178/178 OK), counts (128 boards, 966 frames, 147/123/24, 347 matrix rows, 183 port methods, 24,319 style attributes) and repository state (unchanged: 98 paths, diff 11 files +192/−58), and re-read the board strings the corrections rely on. Two Understand-stage figures did not survive: 23,140 style attributes, and B1-13 repeating the B1-10 defect.
